item.title: Aesthetic High-Protein Overnight Oats & Chia Jar Meal Prep
item.description: Stay on track with weight loss using these gorgeous layered mason jars! Packed with vanilla protein oats, chia pudding, and fresh berries. ~380 Cals & 25g Protein. Ingredients: oats, protein powder, chia seeds, almond milk, berries. Prep: Layer puddings and oats in jars, top with fruit, and chill overnight! #HighProteinMeals #HealthyMealPrep #WeightLossRecipes #LowCalorieMeals #CleanEating
